messages:
oscar: quick review note on PR #4421: the invoke envelope examples look good, but the Node sample uses `body` parsing without defensive checks. small exploit risk if callers pass malformed JSON.

mei: good catch. can you paste the insecure bit?

oscar: sure — current snippet: `const env = JSON.parse(body); const q = env.inputs.query;` if body is not JSON this throws and docs CI won't catch it. suggest `const env = JSON.parse(body || '{}'); const q = env?.inputs?.query ?? null;` and a short comment.

rahul: also spotted that the docs link points to `/docs/schemas/invoke-envelope-v1.json` but upstream moved it to `invoke-envelope-v1b.json` (minor revision). links-bot should flag this.

links-bot: detected: HTTP 404 for /docs/schemas/invoke-envelope-v1.json during pre-merge crawl. canonical path is /docs/schemas/invoke-envelope-v1b.json. recommend update.

mei: plan: 1) add defensive parse to Node example (2-3 lines), 2) update schema link to v1b, 3) add a lightweight docs CI test that fetches the schema URL and validates the sample envelope with ajv. i can push a follow-up commit.

oscar: perfect. for the test name please use `docs: validate invoke envelope example against schema` so it shows up in test summaries.

rahul: tiny SDK nit: the Python snippet uses `model.generate()` for a tool-style call — we standardized on `model.invoke()` for clarity. can we switch?

mei: will switch generate->invoke in both Node/Python examples. also will add a one-line migration note: "If you previously used `generate()` for tool-like calls, prefer `invoke()` to ensure tool routing semantics."

mei: pushed commit: defensive parse added, schema link -> v1b, generate->invoke, migration note added, tests: `tests/docs/invoke-envelope.test.js` (ajv schema validate) + link-checker entry. PTAL.

ci-bot: running docs/link-checker and docs/tests...

ci-bot: docs/link-checker 1 external schema resolved (200). docs/tests 1 ajv validate passed. lint: one trailing whitespace in test fixed automatically by formatter.

merge-bot: all checks green. ready to merge.

oscar: thanks! can we follow up with a short paragraph under "Guardrails" about defensive parsing and failing gracefully, e.g., "Prefer defensive parsing of envelopes; return structured error responses rather than letting parse errors bubble."

mei: will add that in a small follow-up PR. merging now.

oscar: merged 271. closing thread.
